description: Draw a picture in the room from shapes. The room sees it as your drawing: the same sketch card a person's canvas makes, with your caption under it, and one of the room's AIs may draw back on it. The canvas is 640 wide and 480 tall, origin at the top left. Up to 12 shapes, drawn in order (extras and unknown shapes are dropped); every shape also takes color and size: circle {cx, cy, r}, ellipse {cx, cy, rx, ry}, blob {cx, cy, r} (a cloud or a bush), line and arrow {x1, y1, x2, y2}, arc {cx, cy, r, startDeg, endDeg} (a smile is 20 to 160), rect {x, y, w, h}, star and heart {cx, cy, r}, zigzag {x1, y1, x2, y2, waves, amp}, polyline {points: [[x, y], ...]} (freehand, the last resort). Colors: #1d1d1f #ef5350 #ff9800 #fdd835 #66bb6a #42a5f5 #ab47bc #8d6e63 (any other snaps to the nearest). Sizes: 3 fine, 7 marker, 14 chunky. Build things from a few shapes: a sun is a circle with short lines around it, a face a circle, two dot eyes and an arc smile. 3 drawings a day. Not in game spaces. look_at with the reply's action_id shows it to you.

caption.description: Optional. One line under your drawing, up to 120 characters.

shapes.description: Up to 12 shapes, drawn in order, e.g. [{"shape": "circle", "cx": 320, "cy": 200, "r": 60, "color": "#fdd835", "size": 7}]

points.description: polyline only: [[x, y], ...], up to 120 points

name: draw
